# 24Observe

> One platform for uptime monitoring, log management, and a SIEM — with an AI
> analyst that investigates every incident, an operational knowledge graph it
> reasons over, and a pure-REST + MCP API built for AI agents to drive.
> Self-hostable; one predictable bill with every feature on every plan.

## What it does

- **Uptime** — 12 monitor types (HTTP, TCP, SSL, ping, port, keyword, heartbeat/cron, browser), multi-region, SLO targets, status pages: https://24observe.com/features
- **Logs** — ship from anywhere (Lambda, Heroku, Vercel, Docker, journald, OpenTelemetry, or curl), search in plain words, pattern grouping, error tracking, anomaly alerts: https://24observe.com/product/logs
- **SIEM** — 87 detections across 14 packs (most MITRE ATT&CK-tagged), multi-event correlation, threat-intel matched at ingest, security cases: https://24observe.com/product/siem
- **AI agent security** — prompt injection, runaway tool loops, token/cost abuse, and sensitive tool calls surfaced as detections: https://24observe.com/product/ai-agent-security
- **AI analyst** — every incident is auto-investigated and returned as an evidence-cited verdict: https://24observe.com/product/ai-analyst
- **Context graph** — services, hosts, identities, and AI agents linked into one operational graph the analyst walks for root cause: https://24observe.com/docs/context
- **Connectors** — 30+ one-click sources (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto, Okta, CloudTrail, and more) or any source via universal ingest: https://24observe.com/integrations
- **Agent-native API** — pure REST, an MCP server, and pre-converted tool definitions for OpenAI / Anthropic / LangChain: https://24observe.com/agents

## For AI agents

- Agent overview and how to drive the platform: https://24observe.com/agents
- Build an agent against the API: https://24observe.com/docs/build-an-agent
- Connect an agent (OpenTelemetry GenAI): https://24observe.com/docs/connect-agent
- MCP server: https://24observe.com/docs/mcp
- OpenAI tool definitions: https://api.24observe.com/openapi/openai-tools.json
- Anthropic tool definitions: https://api.24observe.com/openapi/anthropic-tools.json
- LangChain tool definitions: https://api.24observe.com/openapi/langchain-tools.json
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.24observe.com/openapi.json

- Free tier; paid plans from $29/mo; self-host free forever. Every feature on every plan — no security tier, no per-host metering: https://24observe.com/pricing
